assessment_summary: The step contains an algebraic error when calculating the distance between $P_n$ and $\omega'(Q_n)$. The points lie on the same ray from $y'$ at distances $m_n a' \frac{b}{a}$ and $m_n b'$, so the distance between them is their difference: $m_n b' - m_n a' \frac{b}{a} = m_n \left(b' - a' \frac{b}{a}\right)$. The text incorrectly claims this distance is equal to $m_n\left(\frac{a}{b} - \frac{a'}{b'}\right)$. These expressions are not equivalent.
